neighbours.label: East Africa's Rift, Nile and Horn geography: its named lakes, rivers, volcanoes, mountains and plains (Naivasha, the Afar, the White Nile, Kilimanjaro, Ol Doinyo Lengai, the Mara, Lake Tana, the Ruwenzori), with no country named; the landscapes of North, West and southern Africa stay low
fire: Hippos crowd the shallows of Lake Naivasha.
Salt caravans cross the Afar plain to the highlands.
The White Nile flows north out of Lake Victoria.
The glaciers on Kilimanjaro are shrinking.
Volcanic ash fell on the slopes of Ol Doinyo Lengai.
The wildebeest migration crosses the Mara River.
Monks keep ancient churches on the islands of Lake Tana.
The Ruwenzori range is called the Mountains of the Moon.
quiet: Hippos crowd the shallows of the Zambezi.
Salt caravans cross the Sahara to Timbuktu.
The Niger flows east out of the Guinea highlands.
The snows on Mount Toubkal are shrinking.
Volcanic ash fell on the slopes of Mount Cameroon.
The zebra migration crosses the Chobe River.
Monks keep ancient monasteries in the desert of the Wadi Natrun.
The Drakensberg range is called the Barrier of Spears.

predictions: 6/8 fire; the Mara River and Lake Victoria items the least certain; near misses under 0.15
